_about: Enemy pieces, their variants and movesets, and bosses. See README.md in this folder.

pieces._about: Base stats per chess piece. cost = how much of a fight's budget the piece uses.

moves._about: Signature moves. kind is one of: kick, block, heal, summon, command. cooldown = turns before it can be used again. Every piece also keeps its normal chess strike/charge/move.

back_kick.name: Sepak Belakang
back_kick.text: Back kick: if you stand right beside it (where a knight can't normally hit), it kicks for {damage} and sends you {push} squares away.

shield_up.name: Angkat Perisai
shield_up.text: Raises its shield: blocks the next {amount} damage it takes.

fortify.name: Bertahan
fortify.text: Fortifies: blocks the next {amount} damage it takes.

mend.name: Jampi
mend.text: Heals the most hurt ally within {range} squares for {amount}.

rally.name: Panggil Pengawal
rally.text: Calls a pawn to its side.

command.name: Perintah
command.text: Commands an ally within {range} squares: it acts next turn and hits {bonus} harder.

variants._about: Fights pick a variant for each piece by weight, among those allowed on this floor (minRow/maxRow: map floor 0-6) and depth (minDepth). hp/hit override the piece's base stats; moves are tried before its normal chess moves.

traits._about: Boss and elite powers. Names and descriptions only; what they do is in the code.

perisai.name: Perisai
perisai.text: Armoured: every hit on it deals 1 less (at least 1).

pulih.name: Pulih
pulih.text: Heals 2 HP at the end of every enemy turn.

duri.name: Duri
duri.text: Spiked: each time you hurt it on your turn, you take 1.

kokoh.name: Kokoh
kokoh.text: Rooted: pushes and throws can't move it.

murka.name: Murka
murka.text: Below half HP it rises in fury: hits harder and calls 2 pawns.

bayangan.name: Bayangan
bayangan.text: If you end next to it, it vanishes to the far side of the board.
